category: crypto market data API (tickers, coin info, exchanges, 365-day OHLCV)

free_tier.stated: Open API with no registration and no key; no strict rate limit, about one request per second recommended; more than 14992 coins and 300+ exchanges
free_tier.notes: The base is api.coinlore.net/api. Tickers return up to 100 coins a request with a start offset; daily OHLCV covers 365 days per coin. A keyless global-stats call answered HTTP 200.

per_object_cap.stated: 100 coins per tickers request, paged with start

retention.notes: OHLCV history is 365 days per coin.

egress.terms: not metered; no quota is stated

interface_detail: GET https://api.coinlore.net/api/global/, /api/tickers/?start=N&limit=100, /api/ticker/?id=ID, /api/coin/ohlcv/?coin=ID and others, JSON, no key
chaining: Keyless crypto tickers and a year of daily candles; it pairs with CoinPaprika for a second source and with FRED for macro series.

limits.value: no strict limit; about 1 request per second recommended

limits_note: Bulk path: page /api/tickers/ in steps of 100 using info.coins_num. Storage terms: unverified, the terms page answered HTTP 404. History is 365 days of daily OHLCV.
binding_note: Only a soft request rate of about 1 a second is stated, so it is the one ceiling that applies.

identity_cost.detail: No registration and no key: the vendor page says the API requires no registration and a keyless call answered HTTP 200.

reliability_note: No strict limit is published; the vendor asks for about one request per second.
confidence_note: The terms of access are read from the vendor page and a keyless call answered HTTP 200; the soft rate was not stress-tested.

evidence.proved: the API is open and needs no registration
evidence.quote: The API is open, requires no registration, and provides real-time crypto market data for more than 14992 coins and 300+ exchanges.

evidence.proved: no key and no strict rate limit, about one request per second
evidence.quote: While there is no strict rate limit, we recommend around one request per second for stable and fair usage.

evidence.proved: 365 days of daily OHLCV per coin
